title: Bilevel Optimization of Synthetic Trajectories for Multi-Turn LLM Fine-Tuning
abstract: arXiv:2605.24743v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: While LLMs excel at single-turn generation, they struggle with long-horizon, multi-turn interactions. Offline reinforcement learning (RL) offers a scalable approach, yet its performance hinges on the availability and quality of multi-turn trajectory data. A common remedy is to augment training with synthetic trajectories generated by LLMs or simulators, but synthetic data is highly heterogeneous in quality, and naively treating all trajectories as equally informative can degrade performance. We propose BOOST, a bilevel optimization framework where the inner level trains the LLM on reweighted data and the outer level trains a lightweight reweighting head on held-out real validation tasks, assigning continuous trajectory-level weights without requiring an external judge. translated_title: 多轮LLM微调中合成轨迹的双层优化
translated_abstract: 尽管大语言模型（LLM）在单轮生成方面表现出色，但它们在长时程、多轮交互方面仍存在困难。离线强化学习（RL）提供了一种可扩展的方法，但其性能取决于多轮轨迹数据的可用性和质量。一种常见的补救措施是利用LLM或模拟器生成的合成轨迹来增强训练，但合成数据的质量高度参差不齐，简单地将所有轨迹视为同等信息量会降低性能。我们提出了BOOST，这是一个双层优化框架：内层在重新加权的数据上训练LLM，外层在留出的真实验证任务上训练一个轻量级的重加权头，从而为轨迹分配连续的轨迹级权重，且无需外部评判器。为了给该方法奠定理论基础，我们推导了一个PAC-Bayesian界，揭示了三方权衡：合成数据增加了多样性但带来任务偏移的风险，而集中……
tldr: 提出BOOST双层优化框架，内层在重加权合成轨迹上训练LLM，外层在真实验证任务上学习轻量级重加权头，无需外部评判器即可自动为合成轨迹分配连续权重，提升多轮微调性能。
en_tdlr: BOOST is a bilevel optimization framework that trains an LLM on reweighted synthetic trajectories (inner level) while learning a lightweight reweighting head on held-out real validation tasks (outer level), assigning continuous trajectory-level weights without an external judge to improve multi-turn fine-tuning.
